messages:
Alice: Heads-up — Q2 hosted capacity planning. Expecting a 35-45% traffic bump May–July from the new PLG cohort + marketing. Need a buy vs lease decision for GPUs. Options on the table: buy ~32 A800s (on-prem EU/US split), lease ~80 H100s (cloud), or a hybrid (24 A800 + cloud burst). Quick cost sketches attached inline. Thoughts?
Ben: Can you post the throughput projection and estimated GPU-hours so I can run the cost model?
Alice: Quick projection: baseline ~1.5M tokens/day -> peak ~3.0M tokens/day. Estimated GPU-hours/week: baseline ~1,200 -> peak ~3,000. Buffer target 25% -> target ~3,750 GPU-hours/week. Assumes ~80 tokens/sec per A800 for gen workloads.
Carlos: 80 tokens/sec seems optimistic for chat with long contexts. Did you factor KV-cache cold starts and multi-turn chats?
Alice: Good catch. With KV cold starts, effective throughput drops ~15%. Adjusted peak GPU-hours/week -> ~3,500.
Dana: Leasing H100s pros: better perf/card (~120 tokens/sec), faster regional rollout. Cons: higher $/hour. Rough TCO for leasing 80 H100s over a 12-week quarter ~ $1.1M. Buying 32 A800s capex ~ $720k + ops/networking.
Evelyn: Note region constraint — EU demand increases in May. Physical rack lead time in EU is 10–12 weeks right now. Cloud lease gives regional flexibility immediately.
Ben: Can we use spot instances for non-SLA traffic (embeddings, offline rerank)? That would lower lease costs.
Carlos: Absolutely. Proposal: reserve capacity for low-latency endpoints only. Offload batch/embed to spot/cloud burst. Split suggestion: 60% reserved dedicated, 30% cloud lease for burst, 10% spot.
Alice: Ops note: on-prem will require uplink upgrades (10Gb -> 40Gb) for expected throughput. NIC + switch upgrades estimate ~ $60k included in capex.
Dana: Also account for hardware redundancy — N+2 per shard. That increases buy count by ~6 cards.
Morgan: Quick cost model snippet I used so folks can reproduce:
```
# per-week gpu-hours
baseline = 1200
peak = 3000
buffer = 0.25
target = int(peak * (1 + buffer))
# H100 perf multiplier = 1.5
```
Happy to share the spreadsheet.
InfraBot: Capacity ticket created: INF-712 — procurement request (owner: Alice). https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-712
Evelyn: :thumbsup: Leaning hybrid. Buy 24 A800s for EU racks (regional latency + cost), lease 40 H100s in cloud for US bursts. That meets redundancy and reduces risk from EU lead times. Order lead times mean we should submit PO ASAP.
Alice: OK — decision sync Thursday 09:30 PT. I'll circulate an updated sheet with KV-adjusted throughput, revised GPU-hour numbers, and full cost comparison (lease vs buy vs hybrid).
Ben: Works for me. Ops — can you prepare network egress/cross-region estimates for EU racks before the call?
Dana: I'll run lifecycle/EOL checks on the A800 SKUs and confirm vendor lead times and warranty SLAs.
Alice: Thanks team — please drop any last-minute numbers in INF-712 thread or ping me directly before 09:00 PT on Thursday.
